findings.body: When the first `limit` characters contain no space, `shorten` returns `head` (exactly `limit` characters) plus the ellipsis — `limit + 1` characters total, one more than the documented “at most `limit` characters.” For a check-run title this can push past GitHub's ceiling by exactly the character the limit was meant to protect. Take `limit - 1` characters before appending the ellipsis so the total stays at `limit`.
findings.title: Keep shorten within the limit when no word boundary is found

findings.body: `runpy` is imported at the top but never called — execution uses `compile` + `exec` directly. The `globals_dict` assignment exists only to suppress the unused-import warning on `runpy` by accessing it, then suppresses its own unused-variable warning with `noqa: F841`. Both the `import runpy` at the top of the file and this line should be deleted; `sys` is still needed for `sys.exit`.
findings.existing_code: globals_dict = runpy.run_path.__globals__  # noqa: F841 - keep runpy imported
findings.title: Remove the unused runpy import and placeholder line

findings.body: The title and body describe only `findings::summarise`, but the diff also renames the GitHub App credentials from `TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_*` to `TINYSWEEPER_*` (fixing a mismatch with the binary's env-var names), adds `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and `COHERE_API_KEY`, mounts `.tinysweeper.toml` into the container, adds an `[embeddings]` block to `.tinysweeper.toml`, and adds a MongoDB kernel-bypass entrypoint with a compose overlay. The repository rule requires PRs to state what changed, the behaviour change, and how verified; these deployment changes are significant and undescribed.
findings.title: Describe the deployment and config changes in the pull request body

value.summary: The PR adds `findings::summarise` (shorten/first_sentence) plus significant deployment infrastructure — a MongoDB kernel-bypass shim, a compose overlay, env-var renaming in docker-compose, an embeddings config block, and a config-file mount — but the title and body describe only the helper. The `shorten` function can return one character more than its stated limit when no word boundary is found, and the kernel-bypass shim carries dead `runpy` code. Safe to merge only if the description is expanded and the two code issues are addressed.
